compliant_spring_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Single-piece print-in-place compliant claw clips (Plate 1). Sliced in dense 95A TPU at a 45-degree toolpath angle with a 45% gyroid infill web to absorb hair torsion stress. Enforces a strict 4-quadrant segmented layout separated by a 15mm clear cross runway. This prevents cross-plate rubber tooth tension during harvest, letting the operator flex independent 4-clip zones locally to achieve warp-free bed release.

compliant_spring_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Alternative high-flex Polypropylene (PP) clip runs (Plate 2). Hardcodes an 8mm outer solid brim and a 45% gyroid core inside a 4-quadrant layout to distribute thermal mass uniformly. Utilizes rapid thermal quenching to freeze the plastic into a highly flexible, amorphous state, preventing brittle crystallization along the folds.
